items.title: Pay therapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Invoice is a private-law claim between the person and the therapy practice, so the statutory counting rules of §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB apply (no deemed-delivery rule for authorities, since the sender is a company). The period starts the day after the invoice date (18.11.2026) per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so counting begins 19.11.2026. 21 days later lands on Wednesday, 09.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). That day is a working day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 09.12.2026.

items.title: Automatic direct debit for separate contract HM-5583-367
items.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 14.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for the next automatic SEPA direct-debit collection under the separate contract HM-5583-367: 14.12.2026 (a Monday, not a public holiday in NW), so this is simply the stated collection date; no further counting needed. This is informational only (the practice will collect it itself) rather than an action the person must take, but the person should ensure sufficient account funds by that date.

warnings: The invoice also mentions a separate, ongoing contract (Vertrag HM-5583-367) with a recurring direct debit; no terms of that contract (start, notice period, price) are given in this letter, so none are reported as a 'contract' object.

The therapy practice's address (35576 Beispielwetzlar) is in Hessen while the patient lives in NRW; this is plausible for a private therapist invoice and not itself suspicious, but the person should verify the IBAN/bank details match the known provider before paying.
No legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) are present, as expected for a private invoice rather than an authority's decision.
